summary: A posted journal entry is permanent in the database itself, open month or closed, any community, any writer (app, script or database function). Lines of a non-draft entry cannot be deleted or changed. A non-draft header never returns to draft, a void is final, and its community, posting date, period, totals and reversal link never change. Drafts stay fully editable; metadata edits, the void flip and the superseded flip / restore are unaffected. Coexists with 502 (closed months) and 528 (former clients). Scar: LOPF JE-2026-00169..00172 lost their lines on 2026-09-28/29. Repairs nothing; no row changes.

expected_changes: New function journal_entry_lines_posted_guard() and trigger trg_journal_entry_lines_posted_guard (BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE on journal_entry_lines): refuses deleting a line of a non-draft entry, changing any column of such a line, and moving a line into a non-draft entry. A write that changes nothing passes. Message starts 'posted_lines_immutable:' (P0001).

New function journal_entries_posted_guard() and trigger trg_journal_entries_posted_guard (BEFORE UPDATE on journal_entries): a posted / voided / superseded entry never returns to draft; a voided entry stays voided with the same reversal; community_id, posting_date, period_id, total_debits_cents, total_credits_cents and reverses_je_id never change. Description, notes, document links, needs_review, classification_reason, prior_period_through, the void flip and the superseded flip / restore are unaffected.

New function journal_entries_posted_guard() and trigger trg_journal_entries_posted_guard (BEFORE UPDATE on journal_entries), for a posted / voided / superseded entry: never returns to draft; a void is final; posted -> voided only with void_reversal_je_id naming an entry that reverses it (502's rule); posted -> superseded only with superseded_by_conversion set; superseded is final unless a reviewed rollback sets the transaction-local flag trusted.conversion_restore = 'on'; community_id, posting_date, period_id, total_debits_cents, total_credits_cents and reverses_je_id never change. Description, notes, document links, needs_review, classification_reason and prior_period_through stay editable.
Trigger order (Postgres fires same-event BEFORE row triggers by name): books_closed (528) -> close_guard (502) -> posted_guard (529) on both tables.
No row changes. The four LOPF headers JE-2026-00169..00172 stay exactly as they are; their repair is a separate correcting entry approved in the app.
